class.name: LevelBrush
class.brief_description: A convex solid defined by a set of planes, Hammer-style.
class.description: LevelBrush stores a convex volume as a list of outward-facing planes (in local space) plus an optional per-face material. Polygons, edges, and vertices are derived from plane intersections on demand, so plane edits (extrude, clip) always produce a watertight solid. Brushes are added as children of a [LevelMap] node and can be moved, rotated, and scaled like any other [Node3D].

method.name: get_face_material
method.description: Returns the material assigned to [param face], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_face_plane
method.description: Returns the outward-facing plane of [param face].

method.name: set_face_plane
method.description: Replaces the plane of [param face]. The brush geometry is recomputed on next access.

method.name: setup_box
method.description: Initializes this brush as an axis-aligned box covering [param aabb] in local space.
